09f0abdfdcc9cc3038d147028c913c04958925d1.summary: A 2022 defensive blog post by Pepe Berba on hunting for Linux persistence through systemd services, systemd timers and cron jobs. It describes how these mechanisms can be abused to keep a backdoor running after reboot, including user-level services and modifying existing services. It recommends detection with auditd, osquery, sysmon and auditbeat rules and notes gaps in each approach.
